name: Private Slave
original_name: プライベートスレイブ
source:
Hero is fond of crying women, but he can not reveal his secret to his cheerful girlfriend and thus seeks realization of his dreams with other women.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄喜欢哭泣的女人，但他不能向开朗的女友透露自己的秘密，因而寻求与其他女人一起实现自己的梦想。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-june-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
